historicalBriefUnmodified.name: Habit de présentation
historicalBriefUnmodified.concept: Virgil AT-9 conserve ses deux unités et sa construction; panneaux noirs/ivoire et détails de cérémonie comme habillage de machine, pas un corps humain ajouté.

prompt.name: Habit de présentation
prompt.prompt: Create ONE finished static 2D/2.5D game sprite, one complete character/entity, single neutral pose looking or oriented screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Entire silhouette within frame, at least5percent transparent margins, coherent physical weight and attachments. Truly transparent background. No backdrop, ground plane, cast shadow, haze, UI, text, labels, repeated views, comparison layout or sprite sheet. This is an original CQC costume/design, not a claim of official released-game outfit or recovery of old PNG bytes. VIRGIL AT-9 machine from the provided reference: preserve its exact mechanical identity, proportions and primary construction: a tall cylindrical black central module with slightly domed upper cap, broad circular upper collar with THREE horizontal red illuminated grille bars wrapping around the visible front, vertically stacked circular front optical ports with a small red lower sensor, slim vertical side access-panel strips, and a separate low circular lower support/base RING. These are TWO COMPONENTS of ONE complete machine assembly, not two duplicated robots. Preserve both main cylinder and lower ring/base, the small mechanical separation between them, the width relationship and round geometry. Original ceremonial variant: high-quality black enamel chassis with subtle IVORY METAL segmented front/side panel inlays and slim ivory bands around the lower base, small machined brass fasteners. The ivory pieces are actual bolted machine access panels following the cylinder curvature, NOT human shirt collars or lapels. NO cloth bowtie, no human clothing, no suit arms or legs, no humanoid torso, no face or skin. The red signal grille and optics remain unobstructed. Elegant restrained presentation finish with physically credible metal seams. ONE complete Virgil assembly only, based on the first source image.

visualReview.note: Physically viewed: one complete cylindrical Virgil assembly with separate lower ring/base, three red signal bars, stacked optical ports and curved bolted ivory/black metal panel inlays. No human clothes, duplicate robot or humanoid body.
visualReview.limits: Original CQC interpretation based on inspected prior project sources; no canonical outfit or pixel-perfect source certification. Anchor preliminary.
